Annual estimates by industry

Annual gross = stated annual baseline × marginal unit value × case-specific improvement. Furnace yield uses absolute uplifts of 0.5, 1 and 2 percentage points on feed. Other ranges apply to the consumption or loss pool stated in each case. Gross sums may include overlapping opportunities and workforce-capacity value. Site assumptions and attribution require validation.

Assumption basis and published references

The selected low, base and high bands are conservative planning assumptions for the stated baseline and operating scope. Published references describe specific projects, technologies or complete programs. A site assessment establishes the achievable result.

  • DOE combustion-efficiency guidance connects efficiency improvements with measured excess air and stack temperature.
  • DOE operations and maintenance guide provides context for complete maintenance programs. Incremental monitoring benefits depend on the existing program and feasible corrective work.
  • AspenTech APC application overview provides integrated-control performance context. Each catalogue case uses its own production, consumption or loss denominator. Selected energy cases use conditional base reductions of 1.5–2%, with the required recoverable consumption stated in each case.
  • OECD review of generative-AI productivity evidence describes task-dependent outcomes. Catalogue time savings require a measured task baseline and represent workforce capacity.
